purpose: Targeted generic-only A/B for Order 105 after preserving and auditing the untouched v88 baseline.
change_scope: One generic recovery change: when file.read_text reports a missing path, return bounded case-sensitive exact-basename file candidates from the guest home tree and require the model to explicitly retry. Never select, rewrite, or execute a candidate automatically.

implementation_evidence.parent_diagnosis: The model repeatedly selected file.read_text with a guessed /home/user/SNAKE/snake.py path while the source was under /home/user/Desktop/snake/. The downstream missing-file response exposed no candidate, so the model never read or changed the source and the no-progress window stopped the loop after 119.39 Agent seconds. Evaluator reward was 0.0 and the strict audit was valid.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual_scope: Tests use unrelated transform.py files in multiple synthetic directories, a same-named directory, a case-mismatched file, and an unrelated basename. They require exact case-sensitive basename matching, files only, bounded traversal, unchanged forwarding of the model's first call, explicit model retry, and no automatic candidate execution.
implementation_evidence.model_choice_contract: The failed call is executed exactly as emitted by the model. Recovery returns candidate paths and retry_options only; the model must select and emit the next file.read_text call itself.
implementation_evidence.instruction_top_k: unchanged public action selection and Top-K; no action or schema was added
implementation_evidence.ruff: all active source, scripts, and tests passed lint; changed files passed format checks
implementation_evidence.project_layout: passed, including generic deployment leakage scan and canonical links
implementation_evidence.osworld_evaluator_tree: frozen commit with zero tracked changes

protocol.on_failure: Preserve and audit the untouched baseline, classify the failure, and do not rerun it unchanged. Try at most three materially different generic hypotheses with one targeted A/B each. If all three fail, mark the task task_blocked and immediately advance to the next ledger entry.

selection.method: targeted A/B for the current first non-pass ledger task
